KAFKA-15773.title: Group protocol configuration should be validated
KAFKA-15773.description:
If the user specifies using the generic group, or not specifying the group.protocol config at all, we should invalidate all group.remote.assignor

 

If group.local.assignor and group.remote.assignor are both configured, we should also invalidate the configuration

 

This is an optimization/user experience improvement.

KAFKA-17179.title: Don't add `integration` tag when using `ClusterTestExtensions`
KAFKA-17179.description:
KAFKA-17172 integrates the `@Tag("integration")` to `ClusterTest` and `ClusterTemplate`, so we don't need to declare `@Tag("integration")` on class level.

In fact, declaring it on class level will cause issue when running unit test. For example: `DescribeConsumerGroupTest` [0] is composed of UT and IT, but it has `@Tag("integration")` on class-level. Hence, `./gradlew cleanTest tools:unitTest --tests DescribeConsumerGroupTest` will get error due to "No tests found"


[0] https://github.com/apache/kafka/blob/90b779b7bb8b813e52ea21ce88c209e71b475ec9/tools/src/test/java/org/apache/kafka/tools/consumer/group/DescribeConsumerGroupTest.java#L73

commits.message: Remove integration tag in class level when using ClusterTestExtensions
commits.author: mingyen066

commits.message: Remove all integration tag in class level when using ClusterTestExtensions

KAFKA-17175.title: Remove interface `BrokerNode` and `ControllerNode`
KAFKA-17175.description:
After KAFKA-16560, `BrokerNode` and `ControllerNode` are almost the same. Hence, it is time to remove them.

This issue should be composed by following changes.

1. remove BrokerNode
2. remove ControllerNode
3. move the BrokerNode.Builder to TestKitNode
4. move the ControllerNode.Builder to TestKitNode
5. add default `logDataDirectories` to TestKitNode. it can be implemented by `initialMetaPropertiesEnsemble().logDirProps().keySet();`
6. remove `boolean combined();` from `TestKitNode` since it can be replaced by `TestKitNodes.isCombined()`

commits.message: KAFKA-17175: change method scope from public to private
commits.author: frankvicky

KAFKA-16818.title: Move event processing-related tests from ConsumerNetworkThreadTest to ApplicationEventProcessorTest
KAFKA-16818.description:
The {{ConsumerNetworkThreadTest}} currently has a number of tests which do the following:
 # Add event of type _T_ to the event queue
 # Call {{ConsumerNetworkThread.runOnce()}} to dequeue the events and call {{ApplicationEventProcessor.process()}}
 # Verify that the appropriate {{ApplicationEventProcessor}} process method was invoked for the event

Those types of tests should be moved to {{{}ApplicationEventProcessorTest{}}}.
